reason: A provides the more mechanism-specific comparison—multiphase versus matched single-phase material—with phase-resolved potential mapping and evidence directly supporting oxide rupture and FCC/σ galvanic corrosion; B’s cited evidence does not establish its proposed FCC/B2 galvanic mechanism, and its combined-versus-isolated test cannot uniquely attribute synergy to phase boundaries. Both proposals require correction because an ordinary 3.5 wt.% aqueous NaCl solution cannot be used at 600–700°C without a defined high-pressure system or replacement by a molten-salt/hot-corrosion environment.
